normative_extracts.quote: An import map allows documents to control the resolution of bare module specifiers to URLs, enabling multiple scripts to share a single module instance in the module map.

pipeline_phases: DOM & CSS Boundary Attachment (ShadowRoot vs Iframe)
Global Scope Isolation (Proxy Sandbox vs Browsing Context)
engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Isolation models trade shared-heap efficiency (Import Maps + Shadow DOM) against hard process and origin boundaries (cross-origin iframes with postMessage).

production_failures.symptom: Unstyled modal dialogs or broken click-outside handlers inside a micro-frontend
production_failures.root_cause: Portaling a modal to document.body moves the DOM subtree outside the ShadowRoot, stripping scoped stylesheets.
production_failures.mitigation: Mount portals onto a dedicated container inside the ShadowRoot or use native top-layer <dialog> elements.

production_failures.symptom: 400 KB extra JS download and conflicting global router state
production_failures.root_cause: Remotes bundle independent copies of the UI framework and router without singleton negotiation in the import map or federation config.
production_failures.mitigation: Pin shared framework dependencies as singletons in the host import map with strict semver ranges.
